items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## Appleby Fall 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Appleby Fall B 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApplebyFallB2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

## No Food or Drink

Appleby College does **not** allow food or drink inside the gymnasium. Please consume any food or drink outside the gymnasium or off-site.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Otsu Biwako Autumn 2023

venue.name: [明日都浜大津](https://e-asuto.co.jp/pages/12/)
venue.address: 〒520-8530 滋賀県大津市浜大津4丁目1番1号

items.information:
本大会は、滋賀県大津市のびわ湖のほとりで行われる大会です。

会場の広さに限りがあるため、本大会では**競技者以外の来場は事前にお申込みいただいている場合を除いてお断りいたします。**
見学および競技者の付き添いを希望される場合は必ず9/16までにフォームにてお申込みください。 詳細は["見学や競技者への同伴"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OtsuBiwakoAutumn2023#31352-spectators-and-guests)のタブをご確認ください。

This competition is held in Otsu City, Shiga Pref. The venue is on the shores of the Biwako Lake, which is the largest lake in Japan.

Due to the limited size of the venue, **no visitors will be allowed to enter at the venue unless registered in advance.**
If you wish to observe or accompany competitors, please be sure to apply to the organization team before 16th September.
Please check ["Spectators and Guests" ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OtsuBiwakoAutumn2023#31352-spectators-and-guests) tab for details.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb05EIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2229da57b72a394620bfac908b137735c3fa4471/WhatsApp%20Image%202023-06-27%20at%203.08.25%20PM.jpeg)
¡Bienvenidos a CICEJ Guadalajara 2023! La segunda competencia del año en la hermosa ciudad de Guadalajara.
Esta competencia será realizada gracias al esfuerzo del Team Jalisco. Te invitamos a disfrutar de La Perla Tapatía y por supuesto de la competencia.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia.

Welcome to CICEJ Guadalajara 2023! The second competition of the year in the beautiful city Guadalajara.
This competition will be held due to the big effort of the Team Jalisco. We invite you to enjoy La Perla Tapatia and of course this competition.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a)

### Speedcubing returns to O'ahu with another WCA competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:45 AM.
